model_details.baseline: DummyRegressor(): predicts the training mean for everyone
model_details.gbm: LGBMRegressor(random_state=0) — defaults: 100 trees, learning rate 0.1, 31 leaves
model_details.tabicl: TabICLRegressor(random_state=0) — pretrained tabular foundation model, Apache-2.0

splits.kfold: KFold(5, shuffle=True): one row per patient
splits.random: Random rows: KFold(5, shuffle=True), ignoring patient ID
splits.temporal: Known patients, later visits: each patient's recordings in time order; train on earlier visits, test on the next block
splits.group: New patients: GroupKFold(5) by patient ID
